يقتلعوا (form VIII)
# يَقْتَلِعُوا (yaqtaliʕū) /jaq.ta.li.ʕuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَلَعَ (iqtalaʕa)
# يُقْتَلَعُوا (yuqtalaʕū) /juq.ta.la.ʕuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَلَعَ (iqtalaʕa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
